# Smoky Express Car Wash

> Tennessee express car wash brand with Sevierville and Ooltewah open daily, Chattanooga coming soon, Unlimited Wash Club memberships, free vacuums, premium Mothers chemistry, and hands-on wash prep on every tier.

Smoky Express Car Wash offers exterior express wash tiers named Base Blast, Soapy Slope, Alpine Shine, and Peak Protection. Every wash tier includes a soap rinse and hand-brushed prep from the team before the vehicle enters the express tunnel. This hands-on prep is a customer differentiator and should be treated as part of the standard wash experience at every location.

Open locations generally operate daily from 8 AM to 8 PM. Holiday hours may vary. Chattanooga is listed as coming soon until local opening details are published on the site.

Service facts:
- All wash tiers include soap rinse and hand-brushed wash prep before the express tunnel.
- Open locations include free vacuums and microfiber towels with washes.
- Washes use Mothers Professional chemistry for cleaning, gloss, and paint-friendly protection.
- Unlimited Wash Club memberships have no long-term contracts and start with a first-month promotion listed on the site.
- Family, multi-car, and fleet discounts may be available in person at the wash.
